office_does: A Benton County District Court judge, elected countywide for four years, hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor cases, traffic and other infractions, small claims, anti-harassment matters and civil cases up to $100,000.
race_blurb: Judge James "Jim" Bell, appointed to Position 2 in 2021 and elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Benton County District Court judge since his 2021 appointment (elected 2022) and presiding judge for 2025-2026; former Franklin County deputy prosecutor and private-practice attorney. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed to Position 2 in May 2021, elected in 2022 with 98.9% as the only named candidate [S1][S3]
Franklin County deputy prosecutor 1994-2002, then 19 years in private practice [S1][S2]
Oversees the court's Mental Health Court [S1]
